{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script (translated from Slurm)

# Slurm requested:
#   --partition=gpu8_long
#   --nodes=1
#   --ntasks-per-node=1
#   --gres=gpu:1
#   --time=5-13:00:00
#   --mem=70GB
#   --mail-type=END
#   --mail-user=foo@bar.com
#   --output=foo.txt

flux alloc \
  -N 1 \
  -n 1 \
  --gpus=1 \
  --time=133h \
  --queue=gpu8_long \
  bash -lc '

# Approximate Slurm --output=foo.txt by redirecting stdout/stderr.
exec >foo.txt 2>&1

# NOTE: Slurm --mem=70GB has no universally portable Flux directive in a batch script.
# Performance implication: without a memory request/limit, the job may be placed where less memory is available,
# increasing risk of OOM or contention.

# NOTE: Slurm email notifications (--mail-user/--mail-type=END) have no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none for runtime, but you will not receive end-of-job email.

module load matlab/

module load anaconda3/cpu/5.2.0
module load cuda90/toolkit/9.1.176
module load cuda90/fft/9.1.176

cd /scratch/td2201/

python ml_is_good.py
'
"
}
